chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Abū ʿAlī al-Ashʿarī, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Jabbār, from al-Ḥajjāl, from ʿAlī ibn Shajarah, from Abū al-Wafāʾ al-Murādī, from Sadīr, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever loves to walk in the manner of the noble recording angels, then let him walk at the two sides of the bier.

key_terms.الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ: the noble recording angels who record deeds

ai.seo_question: How should one walk with the bier in a funeral procession according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the proper etiquette of accompanying the bier during a funeral procession. It recommends walking at the two sides of the bier, presenting this manner as resembling the way of the noble recording angels.
